title: He's awful / What did they do?
subtitle: 他讨厌透了 / 他们做了什么？

lead.question: 如果有个讨厌的人反复给你打电话，你会对朋友怎么形容他？又会怎么用英语讲「他昨天打了四次电话」这种过去的事？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象一个烦人的追求者：昨天打了 4 次、前天 3 次、连你老板都接了他的电话。简问波琳「罗恩·马斯顿是怎样一个人」，波琳答「他讨厌透了」，然后用一般过去时把一连串扰民行为讲了出来。注意规则动词加 -ed（telephoned, answered），不规则动词变过去式（say→said, do→did）。第 72 课用 What did … do? 把各种动词的过去式套进问答。
goals: 理解 What's … like? 询问品行/外貌
能用一般过去时陈述过去的事（规则与不规则动词）
能用 Did …? 提问并用 Yes, he did. / No, he didn't. 简略回答
掌握 four times、the day before yesterday、answer the phone 等表达
lead.summary: 第 71 课是简和波琳的对话：波琳抱怨罗恩·马斯顿「他讨厌透了」，昨天打 4 次、前天 3 次电话，连老板都替她挡过；波琳最后假扮母亲让他别再打。全课集中操练一般过去时（telephoned, answered, said, arrived, didn't answer）。第 72 课用 What did … do …? 把 cleaned/opened/sharpened/listened 等过去式套进问答。
lead.tips: ① 规则动词加 -ed（telephoned, answered, arrived）；② 不规则：say→said, do→did, go→went；③ four times 四次（time 表「次数」可数）；④ the day before yesterday 前天；⑤ answer the phone / answer the telephone 接电话；⑥ Did he telephone again? 简略回答 Yes, he did. / No, he didn't.（did 问 did 答）。

questions.q: How did Pauline answer the telephone at nine o'clock?
questions.zh: 波琳在 9 点钟接电话时是怎么说的？
questions.a: She said, "This is Pauline's mother. Please don't telephone my daughter again!"
questions.aZh: 她说：「我是波琳的母亲。请不要再给我女儿打电话了！」
questions.hint: 听最后一段：What did you say to him? / I said …

questions.q: How many times did Ron telephone Pauline yesterday and the day before yesterday?
questions.zh: 罗恩昨天和前天分别给波琳打了几次电话？
questions.a: Four times yesterday and three times the day before yesterday.
questions.aZh: 昨天 4 次，前天 3 次。
questions.hint: He telephoned me four times yesterday, and three times the day before yesterday.

questions.q: Who answered the telephone at the office?
questions.zh: 办公室里是谁接的电话？

questions.q: What did the boss say to Ron?
questions.a: He said, "Pauline is typing letters. She can't speak to you now!"
questions.aZh: 他说：「波琳正在打信，她现在不能同你讲话！」
questions.hint: What did your boss say to him?

questions.q: Why does Pauline pretend to be her own mother on the phone?
questions.zh: 波琳为什么在电话里假扮自己的母亲？
questions.a: She is fed up with Ron's calls and wants to frighten him off by sounding like a strict parent telling him to stop calling her daughter.
questions.aZh: 她受够了罗恩的骚扰电话，想用「母亲」的口吻吓退他，让他别再打给她女儿。
questions.hint: 想一想「不要再给我女儿打电话」这句话的用意。

questions.zh: ……在……做了什么？——……（过去式动作）。（用一般过去时操练 What did … do? 问答）
questions.a: What did they do yesterday? They cleaned their shoes yesterday.
questions.aZh: 他们昨天做了什么？他们昨天擦了鞋。
questions.hint: 疑问句用 did + 动词原形；回答用过去式。

meanings.usage: He telephoned me four times. / answer the telephone 接电话

examples.en: He telephoned me four times yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天给我打了 4 次电话。

examples.en: He telephoned me four times yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天给我打了 4 次电话。

last night 昨夜；last year 去年

examples.en: Did he telephone again last night?
But I didn't answer the phone!

lines.speaker: JANE
lines.zh: 罗恩·马斯顿是怎样一个人，波琳？
lines.note: What's … like? 询问品行/外貌。

lines.speaker: PAULINE
lines.en: He's awful! He telephoned me four times yesterday, and three times the day before yesterday.
lines.zh: 他讨厌透了！他昨天给我打了 4 次电话，前天打了 3 次。
lines.note: telephoned 规则动词过去式；the day before yesterday 前天。

lines.speaker: PAULINE
lines.en: He telephoned the office yesterday morning and yesterday afternoon. My boss answered the telephone.
lines.zh: 他昨天上午和下午把电话打到了我的办公室。是我的老板接的。

lines.speaker: JANE
lines.en: What did your boss say to him?
lines.zh: 你老板是怎么对他说的？

lines.speaker: PAULINE
lines.en: He said, "Pauline is typing letters. She can't speak to you now!"
lines.zh: 他说：「波琳正在打信，她现在不能同你讲话！」

lines.speaker: PAULINE
lines.en: Then I arrived home at six o'clock yesterday evening. He telephoned again. But I didn't answer the phone!
lines.zh: 后来，我昨晚 6 点钟回到家里。他又打来电话，但我没接！
lines.note: arrived 规则动词过去式；didn't answer 过去否定。

lines.speaker: JANE
lines.en: Did he telephone again last night?
lines.zh: 他昨夜里又打电话了吗？

lines.speaker: PAULINE
lines.en: Yes, he did. He telephoned at nine o'clock.
lines.zh: 是的，打了。他在 9 点钟又打电话。
lines.note: Did 问 did 答：Yes, he did.

lines.speaker: JANE
lines.en: What did you say to him?

lines.speaker: PAULINE
lines.en: I said, "This is Pauline's mother. Please don't telephone my daughter again!"
lines.zh: 我说：「我是波琳的母亲。请不要再给我女儿打电话了！」

drill.zh: ……在……做了什么？——……（过去式动作）。（用一般过去时操练 What did … do? 问答）

slots.zh: 他们 — 昨天 — 擦了鞋

slots.en: he — last night — opened the box
slots.zh: 他 — 昨夜 — 打开了盒子

slots.en: they — this morning — sharpened their pencils
slots.zh: 他们 — 今天早上 — 削了铅笔

slots.en: she — this evening — turned on the television
slots.zh: 她 — 今天晚上 — 打开了电视

slots.en: she — last night — listened to the radio
slots.zh: 她 — 昨夜 — 听了收音机

slots.en: she — yesterday morning — boiled an egg
slots.zh: 她 — 昨天早上 — 煮了一个蛋

slots.en: they — yesterday afternoon — played a game
slots.zh: 他们 — 昨天下午 — 玩了个游戏

slots.en: he — in the morning the day before yesterday — stayed in bed
slots.zh: 他 — 前天早上 — 呆在床上

slots.en: she — yesterday evening — telephoned her husband
slots.zh: 她 — 昨天晚上 — 给丈夫打了电话

slots.en: she — the night before last — called the doctor
slots.zh: 她 — 前天夜里 — 叫了医生

answers: What did they do yesterday? They cleaned their shoes yesterday.
What did he do last night? He opened the box last night.

exercises.q: 把 He telephones me every day. 改成过去式（昨天）。
exercises.note: 规则动词 telephone 的过去式加 -d 成 telephoned。

exercises.q: 写出 say 的过去式，并造句：老板说「她正在打字」。
exercises.a: said；My boss said, "She is typing letters."
exercises.note: say 是不规则动词，过去式 said /sed/。

exercises.q: 汉译英：他前天给我打了 3 次电话。
exercises.a: He telephoned me three times the day before yesterday.
exercises.note: the day before yesterday 前天；times 次数可数。

exercises.q: 对 Did he telephone again? 作否定简略回答。
第 72 课：What did she do last night? 的回答（听收音机）。
exercises.a: She listened to the radio last night.

exercises.q: 改错：He telephoned to me four time yesterday.
exercises.a: He telephoned me four times yesterday.
exercises.note: telephone 是及物动词，直接接宾语，不用 to；time 表次数用复数 times。

exercises.q: 汉译英：请别再给我女儿打电话了。
exercises.a: Please don't telephone my daughter again!
exercises.note: 祈使句否定用 don't + 动词原形。

did 问 did 答，简略回答用 did。

the day before yesterday 前天。

grammar.title: 一般过去时（2）——规则与不规则动词
grammar.structure: 规则动词：动词 + -ed / -d；不规则动词：特殊过去式（say→said, do→did, go→went）
grammar.definition: 叙述过去发生的动作或状态，动词用过去式。规则动词一般在词尾加 -ed（以 -e 结尾加 -d，如 telephoned, arrived）；不规则动词需单独记忆。
grammar.usage: 常与 yesterday, the day before yesterday, last night 等过去时间状语连用。

examples.en: He telephoned me four times yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天给我打了 4 次电话。

grammar.title: Did …? 一般过去时疑问句与简略回答
grammar.structure: Did + 主语 + 动词原形? — Yes, 主语 did. / No, 主语 didn't.
grammar.definition: 实义动词的过去时疑问句借助助动词 did，后面的动词还原成原形；简略回答用 did 回答。
grammar.usage: 询问过去是否发生某事。

examples.en: Did he telephone again last night? — Yes, he did.
examples.zh: 他昨夜又打电话了吗？——打了。

examples.en: Did he telephone again? — No, he didn't.

phrases.usage: ……是怎样一个人/物？（问品行或外貌）

examples.zh: 罗恩·马斯顿是怎样一个人，波琳？

phrases.phrase: answer the telephone / answer the phone

examples.zh: 他前天给我打了 3 次电话。

examples.en: She can't speak to you now!
